name: Linktree
whatYouLose: Built-in creator marketplace and brand discovery
Large-scale click analytics and ad retargeting tools
prompt: Build a mobile-first link-in-bio platform. Users can create a public profile, upload an avatar, add and reorder links, schedule links, choose themes, use a custom slug, view first-party click counts, export data, and generate a QR code. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite. Add an owner-only admin route protected by a single environment password, accessible markup, fast loading, Open Graph metadata and a clean onboarding flow.
notes: A polished personal version can be built in an afternoon. The network, payment products and scale are what you are actually paying for.
